body: REDGARDEN commit 2c4ad3d. Ada already had full lore (#112); Abraham needed new writing (#113, The Unbound Historicals -- disputed author of the real grimoire behind Crowley's actual Abramelin Operation). ARENA_HERO_COUNT 15->17. Abraham: caster with a toggle that boosts Q's damage (new toggle shape), R a full self-cleanse+heal. Ada: tank/controller, Q roots at range, W toggled armor, R damage+root. Wired into every real call site. Verified via build.sh, build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh, test_10_bots.sh, and a local mingw cross-compile, all clean. Closes BACKLOG S170-103.
